programme.title: MADUN
programme.desc: The Madun series tells the story of Madun (16 years old) and his journey to achieve his dream of becoming a soccer player. His father, Syafei (50 years old), who is of Medan descent, really wants his son to become an Islamic teacher. Because of this, Syafei always hinders Madun's efforts to achieve his dream. For him, Madun only has one choice, which is to become a religious scholar. Madun's mother, Kirana, a native of Batavia, is torn. She must obey her husband, who is anti-soccer. However, on the other hand, she also does not want to prevent Madun from realizing his dreams. She cannot bear to restrain Madun, who loves soccer. However, to realize his dream, Madun faces a lot of competition.

programme.title: Little Angel

programme.title: COCOMELON IND
programme.desc: With Indonesian-language 3D animations and songs, Cocomelon creates a world centered around the everyday experiences of young children. In addition to helping preschoolers learn letters, numbers, animal sounds, colors, and more, the videos provide lessons in social skills. They give parents the opportunity to teach and play with their children as they watch together.

programme.title: NUMBERBLOCKS
programme.desc: Numberblocks is an educational animated series for preschoolers that teaches mathematical concepts through lively, adventurous number block characters. Each number block has its own numerical value and unique personality. They join forces and interact with each other to solve mathematical problems while teaching basic mathematical concepts such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and other concepts. Each episode of “Numberblocks” typically features a short story in which the number blocks work together to complete a task or face a mathematical challenge. Through songs, engaging stories, and bright visuals, the series aims to introduce and reinforce children's understanding of numbers and basic mathematical concepts in a fun and interactive way.

programme.title: PINKFONG & FRIENDS

programme.title: TAYO, THE LITTLE BUS
programme.desc: In a big city where various vehicles happily coexist, the little bus Tayo has just started learning his route around town. There are many things for Tayo to learn. Tayo and his friends, Rogi, Lani, and Gani, help each other to become great grown-up buses.

programme.title: KATURI
programme.desc: Katuri is an exciting show about four peacock chicks growing up in a natural forest under the gentle care and affection of Mother Flora. Mother Flora always encourages her children to explore the world with other animals and helps them whenever they need it. When the peacock chicks encounter difficulties or even danger, Mother Flora is always there to keep them safe.

programme.title: PORORO, THE LITTLE PENGUIN
programme.desc: Pororo the little penguin and his friends live in a peaceful land covered in snow and ice. They all have different personalities and interests, which sometimes cause a little trouble in their quiet winter world. But together, every day is an adventure where they learn all of life's lessons, big and small!

programme.title: BING
programme.desc: Let's get to know Bing, a cute and curious little rabbit! Together with his beloved adult friend, Flop, Bing always finds exciting new things every day. From playing with bubbles, tying shoelaces, to overcoming sadness, everything becomes a fun adventure! Come on, follow the adventures of Bing and his friends! We can learn many things while laughing, you know!

programme.title: BLUEY
programme.desc: Bluey is an Australian animated series that follows the daily adventures of a six-year-old blue heeler puppy named Bluey. Together with her younger brother, Bingo, and her parents, Bandit and Chilli, Bluey engages in imaginative games that spark curiosity and creativity.

programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: A simple family from the big city decides to leave the glitz and glamour of urban life behind and return to the village for the sake of their child, who is afraid to go to school. In the village, they interact with friends, neighbors, and local animals, causing endless awkward and funny situations. However, amid all the silliness, there are also touching moments of togetherness, where laughter and tears go hand in hand. Tiantian, the six-year-old child, full of curiosity and love for the world, begins to develop into a healthy, independent, and confident person amidst the beauty of the countryside.

programme.title: CIPUNG ABUBU
programme.desc: It all began with the birth of Rayyanza Malik Ahmad (Cipung), the second son of Raffi Ahmad and Nagita Slavina, who brought happiness to everyone, even his cousins Zayn and Zuney. However, unlike Rafathar, the eldest child, he felt jealous because he thought all the attention was being taken by Cipung. Then a miracle happened when fairy dust touched Cipung, Rafathar, Zayn, and Zuney. The fairy dust transformed the babies into magical babies and took them to the world of Boba, a place for children where all miracles can happen and without adults knowing. From that moment on, the adventure began. Together with the Boba, the creatures who work there, they created magical tools and encountered various amazing creatures such as tauge monsters, viruses, zombies, snowmen, and even met Supercool, who heightened the adrenaline of their adventure.

programme.title: RAINBOW BUBBLEGEM
programme.desc: In the underwater world, a mermaid named Purple longs for adventures on land and secretly takes a huge risk by transforming herself into a human. With the help of Pink Star, the sleeping guardian fairy of the bubblegem, Purple transforms. However, the excessive use of magic causes the bubblegem, their source of power, to shatter and scatter across the land. To gather the scattered bubblegems, the sea queen White Gold commands seven mermaids from different sea kingdoms.

programme.title: SUNNY GIRL NO.23
programme.desc: **SUNNY GIRL NO.23** is not only about the growth journey of a cheerful young girl, but also the first realistic-themed animated series that reflects parent-child education and school life in China. The main character is an 8-year-old elementary school student. She is not extraordinary. She is a clumsy girl, but also energetic, optimistic, and kind-hearted, with a talent for drawing, creativity, and problem-solving abilities that many children can relate to. This animation has been well received by audiences in Mainland China and has also been distributed across Southeast Asia, including Malaysia and Vietnam. The first season expresses a worldview through 26 humorous stories: *"There are many different forms of excellence, and every child is exceptional in their own way."* It not only portrays the childhood experiences of contemporary elementary school students but also explores the clash between traditional and modern parenting concepts. The second season continues and further develops this worldview.

programme.title: NEW KELUARGA SOMAT S2
programme.desc: FOLLOW THE EXCITING ADVENTURES OF PAK SOMAT'S FAMILY AS THEY START A NEW LIFE IN CITEKO! From building BU INAH'S dream food stall, dealing with the lively antics of their neighbor CEU KOKOM, to PAK SOMAT'S efforts to become an online motorcycle taxi driver for his family. A heartwarming story filled with laughter and moral lessons, suitable for all ages.

programme.title: BIOSKOP KELUARGA INDONESIA (PORORO DRAGON CASTLE ADVENTURE)
programme.desc: Pororo and his friends begin a magical adventure to the Dragon Castle to help the Dragon King fight an evil wizard named Gad. Will they be able to save the King’s power and protect the peace of the Dragon Castle? Watch their exciting adventure only on Mentari TV!

programme.title: POKEMON SEASON 23: THE JOURNEYS
programme.desc: POKEMON JOURNEYS IS A POKEMON ANIME SERIES THAT FOLLOWS THE ADVENTURES OF A POKEMON TRAINER NAMED ASH KETCHUM AND HIS FRIEND, GOH. THEY JOURNEY ACROSS VARIOUS POKEMON REGIONS TO CHASING THEIR DREAMS. IN THEIR ADVENTURES, THEY MEET LEGENDARY POKEMON, BATTLE AGAINST POWERFUL TRAINER, AND LEARN MANY NEW THINGS ABOUT POKEMON. programme.title: Mentari TV
programme.desc: Mentari TV is a national television station from Indonesia that broadcasts various educational and family entertainment programs, with a primary focus on children and teenagers.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: Oddbods is an animated, slapstick comedy that embraces adventure and celebrates friendship. Following the wacky adventures of eight unique and furry friends, who laugh, play and get up to mischief in their hometown of Oddsville, where even the most ordinary of situations have unexpected outcomes.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Little Angel is an animated musical show for pre-schoolers. The show has been captivating families around the world with its cheeky humor and catchy upbeat songs.

programme.title: COCOMELON IND
programme.desc: With Indonesian-language 3D animations and songs, Cocomelon creates a world centered around the everyday experiences of young children. In addition to helping preschoolers learn letters, numbers, animal sounds, colors, and more, the videos provide lessons in social skills. They give parents the opportunity to teach and play with their children as they watch together.

programme.title: NUMBERBLOCKS
programme.desc: Numberblocks is an educational animated series for preschoolers that teaches mathematical concepts through lively, adventurous number block characters. Each number block has its own numerical value and unique personality. They join forces and interact with each other to solve mathematical problems while teaching basic mathematical concepts such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and other concepts. Each episode of “Numberblocks” typically features a short story in which the number blocks work together to complete a task or face a mathematical challenge. Through songs, engaging stories, and bright visuals, the series aims to introduce and reinforce children's understanding of numbers and basic mathematical concepts in a fun and interactive way.

programme.title: PINKFONG & FRIENDS
programme.desc: Each episode features a new story that is both entertaining and educational, with interactive moments that invite children to guess, sing, and share in the joy with the characters.

programme.title: TAYO, THE LITTLE BUS
programme.desc: In a big city where various vehicles happily coexist, the little bus Tayo has just started learning his route around town. There are many things for Tayo to learn. Tayo and his friends, Rogi, Lani, and Gani, help each other to become great grown-up buses.

programme.title: KATURI
programme.desc: Katuri is an exciting show about four peacock chicks growing up in a natural forest under the gentle care and affection of Mother Flora. Mother Flora always encourages her children to explore the world with other animals and helps them whenever they need it. When the peacock chicks encounter difficulties or even danger, Mother Flora is always there to keep them safe.

programme.title: PORORO, THE LITTLE PENGUIN
programme.desc: Pororo the little penguin and his friends live in a peaceful land covered in snow and ice. programme.title: BING

programme.title: Zoom
programme.desc: Former superhero Jack is called back to work to transform an unlikely group of ragtag kids into superheroes at a private academy.

programme.title: She's Funny That Way
programme.desc: On the set of a playwright's new project, a love triangle forms between his wife, her ex-lover and the call-girl-turned-actress cast in the production.

programme.title: Step Brothers (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Two aimless middle-aged losers still living at home are forced against their will to become roommates when their parents marry.

programme.title: The Possession Of Hannah Grace (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: When a cop who is just out of rehab takes the graveyard shift in a city hospital morgue, she faces a series of bizarre, violent events caused by an evil entity in one of the corpses.

programme.title: Baby Driver (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Coerced into working for a crime boss, a young getaway driver must face the music when a doomed heist threatens his life, love, and freedom.

programme.title: The Other Guys
programme.desc: Two mismatched detectives seize an opportunity to step up like the city's top cops whom they idolize, only things don't quite go as planned.

programme.title: Intruder
programme.desc: During one of Oregon's most violent storms, a young cellist seeks solitude and comfort in the safety of her large apartment, but soon realizes she might not be home alone.

programme.title: Force Of Execution
programme.desc: A crime boss who runs a southwestern town needs the help of his former hit-man to deal with a new threat to his empire.

programme.title: Bad Men Must Bleed
programme.desc: Follows a man as he hunts his brother's gang across the old west to stop their rampage.

programme.title: After We Fell
programme.desc: Just as Tessa makes the biggest decision of her life, everything changes. Revelations about her family, and then Hardin's, throw everything they knew before in doubt and makes their future together more difficult.

programme.title: The Super
programme.desc: A man becomes the superintendent of a large New York City apartment building where people mysteriously go missing.

programme.title: American Rider
programme.desc: Two bikers head from L.A. to New Orleans through the open country and desert lands, and along the way they meet a man who bridges a counter-culture gap of which they had been unaware.

programme.title: The Ballad Of Davy Crockett
programme.desc: In 1815, an American Legend, whose wife has fallen deathly ill, leaving his young children to survive on their own, must fight his way back to them across the many perils found in the Savage Lands of the wild frontier.

programme.title: Behaving Badly
programme.desc: Rick Stevens has a crush on Nina Pennington. They form a friendship and take a rock'n'roll journey together while Nina deals with her overbearing boyfriend Kevin.

programme.title: Skin
programme.desc: A destitute young man, raised by racist skinheads and notorious among white supremacists, turns his back on hatred and violence to transform his life, with the help of a black activist and the woman he loves.

programme.title: The Retaliators
programme.desc: An upstanding pastor uncovers a dark and twisted underworld as he searches for answers surrounding his daughter's brutal murder.

programme.title: Revival
programme.desc: One miraculous day in rural Wisconsin the deceased rise from their graves, yet appear and act unchanged. And now it is up to Officer and single mother Dana Cypress to solve a murder case where everyone, alive or undead, is a suspect.

programme.title: Escape Through Africa
programme.desc: A British nurse escapes an attack on her outpost. Hunted by a German-led war party, and with help from local warriors, she embarks on an epic journey to save a neighboring outpost.

programme.title: Gunfight At Dry River
programme.desc: The US-Mexican border in 1888. In Dry River, a desert town debilitated by drought, a promise of gold will bring hope, love, and death in equal measure.

programme.title: Stowaway
programme.desc: A tenacious party girl fights to survive after three thieves commandeer her luxury yacht. Unable to escape, she turns the tables on the intruders and takes matters into her own hands.

programme.title: Riot
programme.desc: Cop Jack Stone robs a Russian mob bank to end in the same prison as the mob boss killing Jack's wife. An inmate helps him as does a reporter. Lots of fights.

programme.title: The Professor And The Madman
programme.desc: The story of Professor James Murray compiling words for the first edition of the Oxford English Dictionary in the mid 19th century.

programme.title: The Room
programme.desc: In San Francisco, an amiable banker's seemingly perfect life is turned upside down when his deceitful fiancée embarks on an affair with his best friend.

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Guns
programme.desc: In the lawless West, a notorious brotherhood of killers and thieves called The Cowboys reigns over the land with brutal fists and fast guns. Fate finally catches up with them.

programme.title: Safer At Home
programme.desc: Two years into the pandemic, a group of friends throw a wild online party. After taking ecstasy, things go terribly wrong and the safety of their homes becomes more terrifying than the raging chaos outside.

programme.title: The Canyons
programme.desc: When Christian, an LA trust-fund kid with casual ties to Hollywood, learns of a secret affair between Tara and Ryan, he spirals out of control, and his cruel mind games escalate into an act of bloody violence.

programme.title: The Junkyard Dogs
programme.desc: Follows a dog who is a master escape artist, who must team up with his puppy pals to prevent their block from being robbed.

programme.title: Edge Of Fear
programme.desc: After being stabbed in the heart by ruthless home invaders, a man is left for dead. Now weak, outnumbered, and knife sticking from his chest, he attempts to do the impossible: save his wife from these murderers before he bleeds to death.

programme.title: War Pigs
programme.desc: A ragtag unit of misfits known as the War Pigs must go behind enemy lines to exterminate Nazis by any means necessary.

programme.title: Burial Ground Massacre
programme.desc: A group of college students spend a night at an old, eerie manor, only to realize that a terrifying stalker is watching their every move as he begins plans to repossess an ancient Native American artifact located inside.

programme.title: Elizabeth Harvest
programme.desc: Elizabeth arrives with her brilliant scientist husband Henry to his magnificent estate. Henry explains that everything in his world now belongs to her, all except for a locked-off room he forbids her from entering.

programme.title: Operation Seawolf
programme.desc: The German Navy and the last remaining U-Boats, were formed together for one last mission to attack the United States Homeland.

programme.title: Detachment
programme.desc: A substitute teacher who drifts from classroom to classroom finds a connection to the students and teachers during his latest assignment.

programme.title: Wunderland
programme.desc: Lt. Cappa and his American infantry platoon are ordered to defend a vital road junction against a German offensive in the Battle of the Bulge. Despite difficult winter conditions, they must hold their position to stop the German advance.

programme.title: Call Me King
programme.desc: In the international world of gun running loyalty, honor and discretion are valuable commodities, but nothing is more priceless than the bond of family. Power begets enemies and a loved ones betrayal cuts like a knife. Sides will be chosen, wars will be fought. In the end, there can only be one King.

programme.title: Semua Karena Ginah
programme.desc: Although she is only an herbalist, Ginah is very attractive. She looks graceful and her friendliness results in many crushes on her.

programme.title: Kawin Kontrak Lagi
programme.desc: Jody’s carefree playboy days take a sharp turn when life drags him into a wild journey with his campus fans. What begins as reckless fun in a mysterious village spirals into chaos, laughter, and surprising twists.

programme.title: Cinta Kembar
programme.desc: Deddy and Herry, have twin girlfriends, Ela and Eli. The love of the two couples is so deep that when the parents of Ela and Eli want to match one of the twins to another man, they refuse.

programme.title: Ateng Minta Kawin
programme.desc: Their parents don't approve of the romance between Ateng and Vivi, so they keep their relationship a secret.

programme.title: Jamila Dan Sang Presiden
programme.desc: Jamila, a convicted murderer of a government official, refuses to file for clemency. She finds her life in turnmoil after facing the relentless pressure and the conflicts with the president and prison guard.

programme.title: Kuntilanak 3
programme.desc: A group of young adventurers enters a sinister jungle to search for their missing friends. Their path crosses with a mysterious woman on her own quest to reach a mystical village, hoping to break a dark curse that threatens her fate.

programme.title: Pokun Roxy
programme.desc: Three young people, Acong, Bedul, and Jupe, arranged a plan to make a profit from Pokun Roxy case. They spread rumors as if they could take photos of it with cellphones.

programme.title: Pohon Keramat
programme.desc: A small family occupies their new home on the cool edge of the city. One day the mother was shocked by the figure of the madman who followed her to office and shouted telling her family to leave the house.

programme.title: Senggol Bacok
programme.desc: When Galang tries to forget her fiance, fate brings him to Laras, a sweet girl who melts his heart. Unfortunately, Galang's temperament distanced himself from Laras.

programme.title: Ummi Aminah
programme.desc: Follows the life of Ummi Aminah, a 68 years old ustadzah who has seven children and loyal congregation.

programme.title: Tiga
programme.desc: Alif, Lam and Mim are three friends from martial art school Al-Ikhlas. All three are reunited after the explosion of a bomb in a cafe.

programme.title: Gentayangan (IMC)
programme.desc: After being declared bankrupt by the court, Abimanyu Karindra has no choice but to bring his wife, their two children and his sister Sheila to settle in a parent's hotel in a mountain valley.

programme.title: Kuntilanak
programme.desc: Sam chooses to stay in an old house next to the cemetery, rather than live with her stepfather. But, no one knows that Sam has the gift to summon the kuntilanak who is believed to be living in a big tree.

Film 13 The Haunted tells the story of a group of millennial youths who do not believe in the mystical world but are curious to learn about it, leading them into a thrilling and terrifying mystical world.

programme.title: Happy Gilmore
programme.desc: When a hot-headed hockey player loses his grandmother’s home to the IRS, he dives into the world of golf, hoping his fierce skills can score enough prize money to win it back.

programme.title: Twister

Once they hatch, the siblings must get creative to keep their new friends hidden after all, no one knows these energetic creatures exist, and predators could be lurking around every corner.

programme.title: Konosuba, Ep 7
programme.desc: High school student Kazuma Satou dies in an unexpectedly embarrassing accident and awakens in the presence of the goddess Aqua. She offers him the opportunity to be reincarnated in a fantasy world to defeat the Demon King. Before leaving, Kazuma is allowed to take one item with him, and he mischievously chooses Aqua herself. Together, the unlikely pair begin their new life in another world, quickly discovering that surviving there is far more difficult than they imagined. Filled with humor, fantasy, and parody, the episode introduces the eccentric characters and comedic adventures that define the series.

programme.title: Hot Door Night
programme.desc: Produced by Sanlih E-Television, Hot Door Night is a long-running variety program hosted by Jacky Wu alongside Chen Han-Dian and Lulu Huang. Each episode features celebrity guests competing in creative games, themed challenges, comedy segments, musical performances, and entertaining talk sessions. Blending humor, competition, and pop culture, the show has become one of Taiwan's highest-rated entertainment programs and has received multiple Golden Bell Award nominations and wins.

programme.title: The Sound Of Happiness
programme.desc: The Sound of Happiness follows the Wu family, led by a respected police officer and his supportive wife. Although he once dreamed of having a son to continue the family legacy, he instead dedicates his life to guiding his four daughters through the joys and hardships of adulthood. As their lives become intertwined with romance, ambition, betrayal, and family rivalries, the family faces countless trials that test their love and resilience. Blending heartfelt relationships with dramatic twists, the series delivers an emotional story about family bonds, forgiveness, and perseverance.

programme.title: The Tradition Story Of Taiwan
programme.desc: Discover the fascinating traditions and folklore of Taiwan in The Tradition Story of Taiwan. Each episode delves into ancient legends, local customs, religious beliefs, historical figures, and cultural practices that continue to shape Taiwanese identity today. Combining storytelling with visits to historical sites and local communities, the program offers viewers an engaging journey through Taiwan's diverse cultural heritage and enduring traditions.

programme.title: NHK World-Japan Spc. Program
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's special program features a variety of programs ranging from news, dramas, travel vlogs, and documentaries, broadcast in English 24 hours a day.

programme.title: Cycle Around Japan Highlights
programme.desc: Selected highlights of CYCLE AROUND JAPAN! Bicycle through inspiring scenery, meet the locals and discover living traditions of a hidden Japan.

programme.title: The Wakey Show
programme.desc: “The Wakey Show” is NHK's first new daily children's program in three years, and it carries on the station's storied past in youth-centric.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: The hosts present the latest news and developments from the world of sports, weather, international politics and economy.

programme.title: NHK World Selection
programme.desc: A selection of acclaimed programs from NHK's domestic channels dubbed into English.

programme.title: Little Charo
programme.desc: Little Charo is an animation series about a Japanese dog who got lost in NY. "I want to see my owner again!" Charo starts his adventure back home. Season 2-7.

programme.title: Japanology Plus
programme.desc: Fresh insights into Japan. Stories behind Japanese life and culture through the eyes of Peter Barakan, a 50-year resident and watcher of Japan.

programme.title: A Cat's-Eye View Of Japan
programme.desc: Globe-trotting wildlife photographer and filmmaker, Iwago Mitsuaki, offers the best of a vast collection of cat footage he took in Japan. On this unique trip around the country, discover the lesser-known charms and customs of regions through the eyes of cats!

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: The hosts present the latest news and developments from the world of sports, weather, international politics and economy.

programme.title: NHK World Selection
programme.desc: A selection of acclaimed programs from NHK's domestic channels dubbed into English.

programme.title: Core Kyoto
programme.desc: The timeless heart of Japan's ancient capital. Against its rich backdrop of culture and tradition, today's Kyoto continues to innovate and inspire.

programme.title: Easy Japanese For Work
programme.desc: Language instructors teach expressions and phrases as well as Japanese business etiquette rules to foreigners who currently work in Japan.

programme.title: Zero Waste Life
programme.desc: Meet people around Japan who strive for a life without waste under the traditional philosophy of "MOTTAINAI," which values cherishing the things we have.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: The hosts present the latest news and developments from the world of sports, weather, international politics and economy.

programme.title: Somewhere Street
programme.desc: A unique walking-eye view of cities around the globe! Chat to the locals and enjoy encounters that only strolling the streets can bring.

programme.title: Education Chance Opens...
programme.desc: Maxine is a university student. She joined a school providing educational support and life advice to international students wanting to enter Japanese high school. This experience changed her life. What insights did she gain?

programme.title: Wind Power And Birds At Risk
programme.desc: Wind power helps fight climate change. But as turbines spread across land and sea, birds face growing risks. This episode explores impacts and mitigation measures to protect birds and the climate.

programme.title: Design Museum Japan
programme.desc: Japanese design is world famous, but that's not because of expensive, stylish or modern products. It's because excellent design exists within the tools and habits of everyday life. In this 10-part series, leading creators visit different parts of the country to hear these unfamiliar stories, revealing rich and complex insights.

programme.title: The Factory Wonders
programme.desc: An entertainment program visiting small and large factories to discover the latest science, hidden artisanship, and enthusiastic people that support traditions of Japanese manufacture.

programme.desc: Shimizu Daisuke investigates various aspects of Japanese culture and traditions, using the technique of time-lapse photography.

programme.desc: The hosts present the latest news and developments from the world of sports, weather, international politics and economy.

programme.title: The Seasons Of Yamato
programme.desc: Here is the high-resolution movie by Koichi Hozan, a videographer living in Nara Prefecture, with exclusive pieces which a pianist, Mine Kawakami, played on the "Hyakunen (100-year-old) Piano." The light and sound create a poetic video to make you experience each season.

programme.title: BOSAI: Science That Can Save...
programme.desc: Japan has a long history of natural disasters. BOSAI examines disaster mitigation measures and lifesaving measures using the power of science.

As the miles pass, the journey becomes more than a physical adventure; it transforms into a deeply personal quest for healing, friendship, and acceptance. programme.title: EAUX TURBULENTES
programme.desc: Eaux Turbulentes follows police investigator Marianne Desbiens as she returns to Queensbury after a career setback. Tasked with investigating the suspicious death of a young Indigenous woman, Marianne finds herself confronting not only a complex criminal case but also painful memories from her own past. As clues emerge, the investigation exposes hidden tensions within the community, family secrets, and unresolved conflicts that have shaped the town for years. Combining crime, suspense, and emotional drama, the series explores themes of justice, identity, family, and reconciliation.

programme.title: L'ABÎME
programme.desc: L'Abîme follows Laurent Lacaze, whose life is shattered when his wife Elsa vanishes without a trace. While the police search for answers, they uncover evidence that Elsa is not the woman everyone believed her to be. As buried secrets emerge and new threats arise, the investigation reveals a complex conspiracy that puts both Laurent and their daughter in grave danger. Combining psychological suspense with family drama, the series keeps viewers guessing until the very end.
